designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1957 when the Corps of Engineers transferred the 4,068-acre Holla Bend cutoff site on the Arkansas River to the Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Transfer of Real Property Act (transfer from the Corps of Engineers)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
